events.title: Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
events.description: More than three decades after the end of apartheid, families of victims of some of the worst crimes of South Africa's past are still fighting for justice. As survivors and perpetrators grow older, a new wave of legal efforts is seeking truth, accountability and reparations before it's too late.

events.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
events.description: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.

events.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after support for pro-Palestinian group
events.description: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

events.title: How Putin may react to the rift between the U.S. and Ukraine
events.description: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.

events.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
events.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

events.title: Germany news: Merz faces conservative youth wing in Bonn
events.description: Friedrich Merz, who has struggled for support within his party, on Saturday meets with the CDU/CSU's 90,000-strong Young Union. In Schleswig-Holstein, 3,000 people are expected at an AfD youth rally. DW has more.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Germany news: Merz faces conservative youth wing in Bonn

events.title: India news: 'Cockroach' party founder Abhijeet Dipke under preventive arrest
events.description: CJP's Abhijeet Dipke is due to appear before a Special Executive Magistrate later in the day. Dipke was detained ahead of a demonstration in New Delhi on Friday. DW has more.

events.title: Brazil: Amazon deforestation lowest in nearly 40 years
events.description: The latest figures show that 3,335 square kilometers of the Amazon rainforest were cleared in the year ending in July, the lowest level since 1988. The drop has been described as an "historic achievement."

events.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
events.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

events.title: White House press secretary Zacharia exiting role after short tenure
events.description: Zacharia, having served only five days in the role, is now the shortest-serving press secretary in White House history. Her departure follows a rocky debut at the podium and controversy surrounding her background.

events.title: At summit, EU leaders pledge support for Ukraine's Zelenskyy
events.description: President Zelenskyy has received words of encouragement from EU leaders, who pledged support for Ukraine's self-defense against Russia. This comes as winter approaches and the US seems to be withdrawing support.

events.title: Germany, France agree on deal to support Europe's struggling car industry
events.description: The two countries said the agreement aimed to safeguard Europe's automotive industry, encouraging development and research. Automakers in Europe have so far struggled to compete with Chinese electric car companies.

events.title: Pope Leo recovering from surgery, will deliver Sunday prayer
events.description: The Vatican has said that Pope Leo XIV is recovering from lung surgery. Photos released on Friday showed the pontiff celebrating Mass at Rome's Gemelli Hospital unaided.

events.title: Trump's new press secretary out after less than week
events.description: White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia was pushed out Friday after less than a week in the high-profile job following a series of blunders that added to distractions for her embattled boss, President Donald Trump.

events.title: Trump says did not order curb to Starshield for Ukraine
events.description: Donald Trump said Friday he did not request a reduction in Starshield services for Ukraine, after tech billionaire Elon Musk insisted any limits on the SpaceX-operated communications system would ultimately have come from the US president.

events.title: Three men sentenced to more than 158 years in jail for murders of surfers​
events.description: Three men have been sentenced to 158 years and nine months each for the murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend.

events.title: Pope Leo to leave hospital today after lung cancer surgery, the Vatican says
events.description: The Pope is set to leave hospital on Saturday four days after his lung cancer surgery, the Vatican has said.

events.title: Drugs fuelling 'horrific' events seen in Waterford, says Irish justice minister
events.description: People who take illegal drugs are "supporting the horrific events we saw in Waterford", Irish justice minister Jim O'Callaghan has said.

events.title: What the Pope said to Putin in call days after lung cancer surgery
events.description: The Pope spoke to Russian President Vladimir Putin on Friday and urged a truce with Ukraine as he continued his recovery from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said.

events.title: Nicolas Maduro and wife deny new torture charges as 'false accusations'
events.description: Ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has rejected newly unsealed torture allegations against him and his wife as "false accusations".

events.title: Burly men in Gaza pull trucks and flip tires in competition of strength
events.description: Burly men in Gaza pulled trucks with ropes and flipped massive tires as part of a strength competition that drew cheers from Palestinian onlookers

events.title: Kenya confirms third Ebola case, a relative of the first patient who died
events.description: Kenya’s health ministry confirmed that a third person tested positive for Ebola on Friday while in quarantine as a known contact of the first patient, who died two days after arriving from Congo
events.ticker_label: 💥 Kenya confirms third Ebola case, a relative of the first patient who died

events.title: Presidential adviser says Ukraine is in talks to lift speed limit on military satellite network
events.description: Ukraine is in talks with SpaceX and the Pentagon to lift a speed cap on its military satellite communication service

events.title: Vatican says Pope Leo to be released from the hospital Saturday, 4 days after lung cancer surgery
events.description: Pope Leo XIV is being released from the hospital on Saturday after lung cancer surgery

events.title: 3 men sentenced to 158 years for the killings of Australian, US surfers in Mexico
events.description: The sentencing marked the end of a lengthy legal process over the killings.

events.title: Brazil says Amazon deforestation fell to the lowest level since 1988
events.description: Brazil’s government announces that annual deforestation in the Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since 1988

events.title: Guterres urges faster action and financing to stop biodiversity loss
events.description: The United Nations Secretary-General appealed on Friday for governments, businesses and communities to accelerate efforts to protect biodiversity for future generations and all life on Earth.

events.title: Alex Murdaugh's defense makes 'high risk' move to show DNA proves he didn't kill family, prosecutor says
events.description: Alex Murdaugh's defense team is betting on a Y-STR DNA test by Othram that prosecutors call "high risk" ahead of his April 2027 murder retrial.

events.title: Fox News Campus Radicals Newsletter: Judeo-Christian values under assault in American schools
events.description: Stay up to date with the Fox News Campus Radicals newsletter.

events.title: Bryan Kohberger fights to remove judge who called him 'worst of the worst,' questioned his honesty
events.description: Bryan Kohberger's new attorney accuses Latah County prosecutors of dodging key arguments in his motion to disqualify Judge Steven Hippler from the case.

events.title: FBI returns 'Most Wanted' fraudster to US after India arrest in alleged $600K SNAP food stamp scheme
events.description: FBI Director Kash Patel announced Manjit Singh Bedi, accused of stealing over $600,000 in SNAP benefits in Tacoma, has been returned from India.

events.title: Horse farm owner gets life in prison for boyfriend's murder after claiming self-defense
events.description: Caylen Deller claimed she shot Chad Mullen in self-defense at her Florida horse farm, but the jury rejected her testimony after just one hour.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital and return to Vatican after surgery to remove lung cancer
events.description: Pope Leo XIV received blood tests and a chest X-ray at Gemelli Hospital confirming he is well enough to return to the Vatican after surgery.

events.title: Trump wishes Pope Leo speedy recovery after lung cancer diagnosis, speaks highly of pontiff's brother
events.description: President Donald Trump revealed Pope Leo XIV's brother is a friend and avid MAGA supporter with memorabilia "all over" his house while wishing the pontiff well.

events.title: Pope Leo undergoes blood tests, X-ray following cancer surgery, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV began walking and resumed eating after thoracic surgery at Rome's Gemelli Hospital, with blood tests and an X-ray being part of his recovery.

events.title: Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
events.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived at Gemelli Hospital in Rome for lung nodule removal after doctors said the growth was identified at a "very early stage." Doctors later confirmed he had a form of lung cancer.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer after surgeons remove part of right lung, Vatican says
